title: Print each item
prompt: The robot reads out its inventory. Print each item in the array on its own line, in order.
hints: A for loop gives you each item in turn.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
